prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The runtime-independent fixture now satisfies the behavioral requirement. Both ZIPs passed validation, their hashes differed, reconciliation refused them, the previous ZIP, manifest, and notes retained their hashes, and cleanup succeeded. The round-six explanation is accurate. Only the required correction to the round-five history remains.

Build-Release.ps1 protects the backup before moving it. The injected unwind immediately after that move preserved all three previous-release files at the reported recovery path with their original hashes. The occupied-destination control also preserved the backup and the occupant.

Git's case-insensitive pathspec applies to the existing production paths. MSBuild preprocessing confirmed the differently cased production user file was imported. Build and receipt admission refused it, receipt admission succeeded after removal, and the separate test-project user file remained accepted.

Package validation and the four-profile audit share DLL SHA-256 684b28efdba53369ebd5c9b199e02c04c6b3c76f697426684a7935f607f91184 and MVID 5a94f398-42b6-42df-a682-4e20167cb829. The receipt binds that DLL to ZIP 23048581 at a76174b. The earlier audit retains its round-five identity.
